title: AAPS displaying 1 day old sensor as 11 days old.
body:
I upgraded to 3.2.0.3 today and am running the latest version of xdrip. I got the sensor start time in AAPS now, yay, but it is showing my sensor at 11 days old instead of 1.

I am using the Dexcom G7 sensor.

Screenshot of AAPS
![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/29897815/587e4595-e9d0-4104-8be2-c994a8bbb581)

Screenshot of xdrip
![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/29897815/26724acc-a093-4b38-88cd-ad8dc4e0b51f)

logs
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13734643/AndroidAPS.log)

comments.body: what is the time of start of sensor?

I checked in the systems status on xdrip and found this: 

![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/29897815/ef844976-deba-422a-8e3b-f8549a74b20f)

![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/29897815/509c325f-32d0-490a-be86-64e176ffc2a4)

So it seems that this is an xdrip bug.
